title: Shared a11y known-violation baseline — tempdoc 615 §13 Move 2
description: Schema for governance/ui-a11y-baseline.v1.json. Registers, per captured surface, the axe rules accepted as known debt in the deterministic route-mock capture state. The Python ui-shot measurement and ui-a11y gate read this file and flag NEW-vs-known violations. The register's v1.json carried a $schema pointer at this path from the day it landed, but the file itself was never written, so nothing validated it; ui-proportion-baseline.schema.json even documents itself as mirroring a shape that did not exist. This file closes that, and scripts/ci/check-ui-baseline-schemas.mjs makes the pointer load-bearing instead of decorative.

captureState.description: Prose record of the capture state these rules were accepted against. A baseline is only meaningful relative to a state, so a row measured under a different fixture set is not comparable.

surfaces.description: One row per captured surface state. `uiShotStep` is the identity here, NOT `surface` — several rows legitimately share a surface name because the same surface is captured in several states (chat has eight; library has two). Draft-07 cannot express 'unique by uiShotStep', so that uniqueness is asserted by scripts/ci/check-ui-baseline-schemas.mjs instead.

items.$comment: The if/then below makes `note` REQUIRED on any row that accepts debt. Accepted debt with no recorded reason is the residue this register exists to prevent: nobody can tell later whether the violation was judged and tolerated or simply never looked at, so it survives forever by default.

surface.description: The surface this capture belongs to (e.g. 'chat', 'library'). A label for grouping and reporting — not a key; see the array description.

uiShotStep.description: The `jsharness ui-shot` step name this row is captured under. The row's identity, and the join to governance/ui-proportion-baseline.v1.json's step registrations.

knownRules.description: axe rule ids ACCEPTED as debt in this capture state (e.g. 'color-contrast'). A violation NOT listed here is NEW and must be investigated, so this list is the whole authority — the shrinking-ratchet contract this register shares with the other UI baselines. An empty list means the capture is clean and any violation is a regression. Regenerate deliberately via scripts/jsharness/experiments/regen_a11y_baseline.py.

note.description: Why this row's debt is accepted, who owns it, and what would retire it — the reasoning that would otherwise live only in a commit message. Expected on any row whose knownRules is non-empty.
